title: India’s small businesses could be the biggest AI winners: World Bank report
description: India’s small businesses could be among the biggest beneficiaries of artificial intelligence, as AI gives even very small firms access to capabilities once largely available only to larger companies, the World Bank said. The technology could help these businesses manage finances, improve customer service, create marketing material and reach customers in overseas markets.

title: Raghuram Rajan pitches AI tax idea for govt coffers amid ‘jobocalypse’ fears
description: Raghuram Rajan proposes taxing artificial intelligence usage by corporations. This tax aims to offset the financial advantage machines currently hold. Companies would also receive incentives for retraining and retaining their employees. AI adoption is expected to increase due to competitive pressures over time. The focus remains on managing the transition and supporting affected workers.
